_doc: Every door input can arrive through for THIS loop. Read by ~/.claude/tools/comms.py, which counts and flags but never opens a message. This file is a DECLARATION, not a router: it says what is ours, so nothing has to guess.
_the_point_of_this_one: Fernwood's declaration exists mostly to record an EXCLUSION, and that is not a gap — it is the doctrine. The app IS the feedback channel; text is NOT. An agent does not fetch her words from a channel she did not route here. So a comms sweep of email is near-irrelevant to this loop by design, and a future runner must never 'improve' coverage by reaching into her messages.

channels.name: app:feedback
channels.note: Mama's Perspective answers. tools/read-mom-feedback.py is the reader.

channels.name: app:observations
channels.note: Field notes. A free-text note has no canon target, so its lifecycle is feedback-log.json, not a probe.

channels.name: app:zone-audio
channels.note: Her VOICE. A channel nobody sweeps is a channel nobody hears — 3 of 5 clips once sat unlistened while the ribbon read green.

channels.name: app:conversations
channels.note: Garden Guru turns. Counted, never read.

channels.name: app:metrics
channels.query: GET /api/metrics (her device bucket, since the last lap)
channels.note: Engagement — what she DID. Promoted to a trigger 2026-08-17; see tools/mom-cycle-status.py.

channels.name: her text messages
channels.note: ⛔ DELIBERATELY OUT OF SCOPE, not unreached-for-lack-of-trying. No sweep, no watcher, no scheduled read — Paul relays, or it is not in the system. A parallel channel that quietly works just as well removes her reason to use the app. Paul-relayed input IS real input; the automatic harvest is what is excluded.

channels.name: email
channels.note: Fernwood has no meaningful inbound email channel. Recorded so a future sweep does not read its own silence here as a finding.
